Frictionless Journey

How SteadyAI works for you

A continuous 4-step loop designed around consistency rather than extreme restriction.

01

Define Baseline & Connect Wearables

Share your fitness goals, dietary restrictions, and injury history. Sync your Apple Health or Google Health Connect wearable metrics.

02

Autonomous Daily Prescription

SteadyAI calculates your exact daily energy balance, macro targets, and a 20-minute tailored progressive workout plan.

03

Frictionless Logging & AI Chat

Snap meal photos to log calories instantly. Complete sets with simple check-offs. Ask your AI Health Copilot anytime you have questions.

04

Clinical Oversight & Evolving Plans

Weekly synthesis reports correlate your progress. Request coach video reviews whenever you want professional form calibration.

Infrastructure & Compliance

Enterprise-Grade AI Architecture

Built for 99.9% uptime, zero hallucination danger, and seamless connectivity with modern LLM ecosystems.

🤖

Multi-Model LLM Failover

If the primary provider encounters rate limits or latency >15s, SteadyAI automatically routes traffic between Gemini 2.5, OpenAI GPT-4o, and Groq Llama 3 with zero user disruption.

🔌

Model Context Protocol (MCP)

SteadyAI implements OpenAI's open MCP standard. Query your health history, log meals, or adjust your progressive overload sets directly inside ChatGPT Plus or Claude desktop.

🔒

HIPAA & GDPR Ready

Row-level tenant isolation, AES-256 encryption at rest, TLS 1.3 in transit, and role-based access control (RBAC). Biometrics and meal photos remain private and confidential.
